svg.title: Chirag Kumar
svg.desc: Chirag Kumar, Android engineer: android · kotlin · on-device ml. Rotating taglines: field apps that work offline and never lose a reading; ml models on the phone, the api as a backup; kotlin + compose, from the camera to the server; talking to smart meters over bluetooth; write it once with kotlin multiplatform. 6 Android apps built at Sujanix; 11 ONNX models running on-device; 124 commits to TrueRead from August to November 2026. A terminal prints whoami.json: base Bengaluru, India; now TrueRead field apps at Sujanix; stack kotlin, compose, onnx; rules: offline room outbox, models aes-gcm and sha-256, fallback local to api; open to Android roles.
